title: Crypto misuse: ioctl_init early return leaks op.key on stack
description: ioctl_init in crypto2dev_fd.c:616 returns -EFAULT directly when copy_from_user fails, bypassing the out_zeroize label that calls memzero_explicit(&op, sizeof(op)). A partial copy_from_user can deposit key bytes from the struct crypto2dev_init_op (op.key[128]) onto the kernel stack without zeroing them. The caller's key material then persists in kernel stack memory until overwritten. Fix: change the copy_from_user error path to goto out_zeroize instead of returning directly. This ensures op.key is always wiped regardless of when the error occurs.
